mosima: Mosima is the Founder and Managing Director of Pishon Executive Search. With over 21 years’ experience in executive search, Mosima has successfully recruited Chief Executive Officers and other senior-level executives for general management roles in a wide range of industries such as financial services, media, mining, engineering, oil and gas, health care, aviation and for various large state-owned enterprises.

Although a generalist, she has interest in assisting SOEs to ensure they place the right candidates. Mosima has also executed numerous expatriate assignments for different locations in Africa such as Kenya, Nigeria, Namibia and Zimbabwe. Mosima joined the world of executive search in 2000 with an international search firm. She then moved to a JSE listed company as an Executive Search Director and a Shareholder. Mosima later founded her own search firm in 2007 called Simas Executive Search, which she ran successfully for four years, prior to joining Signium Africa as a Director and Shareholder. She was the highest biller at Signium Africa for last six years consecutively, and the quality of her work and track record made her a Partner of choice with clients.

Mosima holds a BA degree, a Post Graduate Diploma in Library and Information Science and a Sales and Marketing Management Diploma. Currently studying for a Certificate in Human Resources. Mosima is a mother and a Preacher, which she calls her heartbeat. She often gets invited as a Motivational Speaker.
itu: Reitumetse, also known as Itu, has more than five years’ experience in executive search. She joined the world of executive search in 2019. Itu had an opportunity to work for one of the international search firms as an Assistant to one of the partners where she assisted with administrative and research work. She also assisted in doing proposals and preparing tenders. Itu joined Pishon Executive Search from its inception in 2021 as a Researcher. At Pishon, Itu is responsible for mind mapping, finding candidates, candidate ITC checks, filling out tender documents as well as research reports. Itu’s areas of speciality are financial services and the retail industry.
Itu holds a BCom Degree in Economics and an Honours Degree in Business Management. Itu is a mom and beauty entrepreneur.
kopano: Kopano joined the world of Executive Search in September 2021 and was part of Pishon Executive Search from its inception. She has more than three years’ experience in executive search. Prior to joining Pishon, she worked on a contractual basis as an Administrator for several organisations. As of June 2023, she became one of the Researchers at Pishon. Her current responsibilities are Headhunting candidates for clients, filling in tender documents, preparing proposals and reports. Kopano’s areas of speciality are in the financial services, the industrial and educational sectors.
Kopano holds a National Diploma in Management and is currently studying towards a BCom in Financial Management. Kopano is a mom and an individual that has a passion for Finance and self-development.
